notes: rates come from a benchmark, not from the analysed file
generators released after the bench date are untested
probabilities assume a 50:50 prior unless configured

checks_together.effect: an item that one check supports and the checks together do not is not decided; counted in decision_rules
checks_together.min_sum: ln 2 toward the answer, the rows of the checks that count for D-64

content_rule.measured_on: the scored bytes of each (item, variant, transform)

estimate_in_scale.bound: the estimate in whole points: 34 or less for the clean answer, 65 or more for the AI answer; no prior
estimate_in_scale.effect: an item whose set at α = 0.05 holds one answer while its estimate prints outside that answer's part of the scale is not decided; asked before D-76; counted in decision_rules

fallback_content_check.effect: none: no uncalibrated fallback decision is evaluated

no_check_entered.effect: an item in which no check entered is not assessable and not decided; counted in decision_rules

decision_policy.policy: default statistical conformal decision plus loaded envelope cap plus the cap of content the bench does not hold

strong_codes.effect: none on these metrics: the decisions are at α = 0.05, the level of the moderate codes; the items it weakens at the strong level are counted in decision_rules

supporting_check.effect: an item whose set at α = 0.05 holds one answer that no check supports is not decided; counted in decision_rules; selective_raw_conformal does not take the rule
supporting_check.min_row: ln 2 toward the answer, one check that counts for D-64
